DEPARTMENT OF FISHERIES 
 
RAJYA SABHA 
 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.1063 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 10TH FEBRUARY, 2023 
 
Development of fishing harbours in Andhra Pradesh 
 
1063.   SHRI KANAKAMEDALA RAVINDRA KUMAR: 
 
Will the Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the steps taken by Government to develop fishing harbours in the State of Andhra Pradesh; 
(b) the details of funds that have been earmarked for this purpose; 
(c)  the details of funds released so far for this purpose; and 
(d) the details of programmes/measures for infrastructure augmentation at fishing harbours? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING  
 
      (SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
 
(a) to (d): The Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, 
Government of India,
 under its various schemes has accorded approvals to the proposals of the 
Government of Andhra Pradesh for development of eight fishing harbours and three fish landing centres. 
The details of fishing harbour and fish landing centre proposals approved along with central fund released 
are as below: 
(i) One fishing harbour i.e. Juvvaladinne in Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore District at a total cost of Rs. 
288.80 crore with central share of Rs. 138.30 crore has been approved under Blue Revolution: 
Integrated Development and Management of Fisheries and central funds to the tune of Rs.84.10 
crore have been released.  
 
(ii) Four fishing harbours i.e. Uppada in East Godavari District, Vodarevu in Prakasam District, 
Machilipatnam in Krishna District and Nizampatnam in Guntur District have been approved under 
Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF) for providing interest 
subvention to an 
extent of 3 percent on Rs.150 crore per project.  
 
(iii) Three fish landing centres i.e. Bheemili in Visakhapatnam District, Chintapalli in Vizianagaram 
District and Rajayyapeta in Visakhapatnam District at a total cost of Rs.73.374 crore with a central 
share of Rs.44.024 crore have been approved under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana 
(PMMSY) and central share of Rs.6.77 crore has been released.  
 
(iv) In addition, three fishing harbours i.e. Pudimadaka in Anakapalli District, Budagatlapalem in 
Srikakulam District and Kothapatnam in Prakasam District 
at a total cost of Rs.1137.20 crore with 
a central share of Rs.240 crore have been approved under PMMSY. 
The PMMS
Y and FIDF implemented by the Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, 
Animal Husbandry and Dairying inter-alia envisage for augmentation of infrastructure facilities at 
existing fishing harbours such as construction of landing, berthing, outfitting and repair quay/jetties, 
approach and internal roads, auction halls, gear sheds, net mending sheds, boat repair shop, fish drying 
yard, waters supply and sanitation facilities, boat repair facilities and cold chain facilities like ice plants, 
cold storages etc.

UNSTARRED QUESTION No.1066 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 10TH FEBRUARY 2023 
 
BIRD FLU IN ALAPPUZHA 
 
1066  SMT. JEBI MATHER HISHAM: 
 
Will the Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying  
be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government will take appropriate measures to set up an Institute of High Security 
Animal Disease in Alappuzha, in the wake of intermittent outbreak of Bird Flu in 
Alappuzha district in Kerala; and 
 
(b
) whether Government has taken steps to grant a special package to ensure financial aid to 
the farmers who are at the risk of losing livelihood due to the recent outbreak of Bird Flu? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER FOR FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING 
 (SHRI PARSHOTTAM  RUPALA) 
 
(a) Animal 
Husbandry, including veterinary science, is a State subject. Therefore, setting up a 
disease diagnostic laboratory i.e. an Institute of High Security Animal Disease in Alappuzha, 
is the responsibility of the State. However, the Department of Animal Husbandry and 
Dairying  is implementing the Livestock Health & Disease Control Programme Scheme under 
which States can avail of financial support for strengthening of the ir disease diagnostic 
laboratories.  
 
(b) There is no such special package available under any scheme of the Department of Animal 
Husbandry and Dairying, at present.
 However, u nder ‘Assistance to States for Control of 
Animal Diseases (ASCAD) ’ component of Livestock Health & Disease Control Programme 
(LHDCP), financial assistance on a 50:50 sharing basis between the Central and the State 
Government is provided to farmers whose poultry birds have been culled, eggs and feed 
destroyed,
 after due confirmation of Avian Influenza.

UNSTARRED QUESTION No. 1067 
ANSWERED ON 10TH FEBRUARY, 2023 
  
ODOP PROGRAMME IN VARIOUS STATES 
  
1067. SHRI VIJAY PAL SINGH TOMAR: 
  
   Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
  
(a) the quantum of funds allocated, released, and utilised under the One  District One Product 
(ODOP) programme in various States during the last two years; 
  
(b) whether one of the aims of ODOP is to reduce wastage and provide support for proper storage 
of agricultural products and if so, the steps taken in the States in pursuance of these; and 
  
(c) the status of implementation of ODOP in the State of Uttar Pradesh since the launch of the 
scheme? 
  
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a). The Prime Minister Formalisation of Micro Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme implemented by the 
Ministry of Food Processing Industries adopts One District One Product (ODOP) approach to reap 
the benefits of scale in terms of procurement of inputs, availing co mmon services and marketing of 
products. The State / UT -wise details of funds (Centre share) released under PMFME Scheme is at 
Annexure-I. 
(b). ODOP provides the framework for value chain development and alignment of support 
infrastructure.  States/UTs ide ntify the ODOP based on the agriculture production, raw material 
availability, perishability of the product, presence of micro enterprises, Number of Self-Help Groups 
(SHG) and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPO) engaged in the processing of that product. Ministry 
of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) has approved ODOP for 713 districts of 35 States/ UTs. 
 
(c). ODOP for 75 districts have been approved by MoFPI in the State of Uttar Pradesh as per the 
details at Annexure-II. The following steps have been taken by MoFPI to implement the scheme in 
selected ODOP districts of Uttar Pradesh: 
(i).   State Nodal Department / Agency (SNA), State Leve l Approval Committee (SLAC) and 
District Level Committee (DLCs) have been constituted. 
(ii).   4 nos. of State Level Training Institutes (SLTIs) have been nominated for capacity building. 
(iii). 14 Incubation Centers have been approved. 
(iv).  250 District Resource Persons (DRPs) appointed for facilitating the prospective entrepreneurs 
/ applicants for mobilization of proposals / applications. 
(v).   1879 applications have been submitted in ODOP out of which 340 loans have been sanctioned 
and 221 loans disbursed. 
(vi). 1938 SHG Members for amount of Rs. 5.01 crore have been recommended for seed capital 
out of which an amount of Rs. 4.79 crore has been released to 1879 SHG Members.

ANSWERED ON 10TH FEBRUARY  2023 
  
NEW CAMPUS OF NIFTEM 
 
1068. DR. SUMER SINGH SOLANKI 
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
(a) whether the Government proposes to open new campuses of National Institute of Food 
Technology Entrepreneurship and Management (NIFTEM); 
(b) if so, the details thereof with respect to the state of Madhya Pradesh; and 
(c) the details of the incentives being  provided by the Government for setting  up food 
processing industries by private companies and cooperative sector? 
 
 
ANSWER  
 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a) &(b) There is no such proposal as of now.  
 
(c)   Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) supports setting up/ upgradation of 
Food    Processing Industries through its Central Sector Umbrella Scheme Pradhan Mantri Kisan 
SAMPADA Yojana (PMKSY), Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Food Processing Industries 
(PLISFPI) and Centrally sponsored PM Formalization of Micro Food Processing Enterprises 
(PMFME) scheme across all the states. Under component schemes of PMKSY, MoFPI provides 
mostly credit linked financial assistance (capital subsidy) in the form of grants-in-aid with total outlay 
of Rs. 4600 Cr for 15 th Finance Commission Cycle. Ministry provides financial, technical and 
business support to micro food processing enterprises through PMFME scheme with outlay of Rs. 
10,000 Cr for a period of 5 years from 2020-21 to 2024-25. PLISFPI is targeted to facilitate expansion 
of food processing capacity by creating champion brands in Food Processing Sector with outlay of 
Rs. 10,900 Cr for a period of 6 years (2021 -22 to 2026-27). Private companies and cooperatives are 
also eligible for assistance under the above schemes.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 1072 
 ANSWERED ON 10TH FEBRUARY, 2023 
 
PROCESSING IN AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTION 
 
1072. SHRI NEERAJ DANGI:  
 
     Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
 
(a)  the percentage of the agricultural production being processed in the country at present; 
(b) the remedial steps taken by Government to boost the level of processing and attract investment 
in this sector;  
(c)  whether there is a  substantial lack of necessary research and development in the field of food 
processing in the country, if so, the details thereof; and 
(d) the details of the schemes and awareness programs launched by Government so far in this 
regards? 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a): The Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) had commissioned a study by M/s Deloitte 
titled “Study to determine the level of food processing in India”. As per the stud y report (2021), the 
estimated level of processing (in per cent) for major agricultural commodities are as under: 
Commodity 2015-16  (%) 2018 -19 (%) 
Coarse Cereals 28.3 29.4 
Fruits 2.9 4.5 
Vegetables 2.2 2.70 
Milk 20.1 21.1 
Fish 8.3 15.4 
Meat 22.7 34.2 
 
(b): MoFPI implements various schemes like Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojna (PMKSY), Pradhan 
Mantri Formalization of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) and Production Linked Incentive 
(PLI) Schemes  to create additional post -harvest facilities/ processing infrastructure to boost value 
addition, reduce post -harvest loses, leverage investment and generate employment. The Government  
has also allowed 100% foreign direct investment in food processing sector under the automatic route. 
 
(c): MoFPI implements the scheme of Research  & Development , as a component of PMSKY , for 
extending financial assistance to undertake demand driven R & D work for the benefit of food processing 
sector. Two National Institutes of Food Technology Entrepreneurshi p and Management (NIFTEM)- 
Thanjavur and Kundli , under the Ministry , also undertakes several research programmes  in the food 
processing sector. 
 
(d)  Promotional initiatives of the Ministry are undertaken in order to create awareness about the 
potential and prospect of food processing industry in the country and about schemes/policies of the 
Government by providing assistance for  organizing Workshops, Seminars, Exhibitions and Fairs.  
Promotional activities through the various social media platforms of the Ministry are also undertaken.

‘DEVELOPMENT OF COLD CHAIN CAPACITY’ 
  
1073.   SHRI KARTIYKEYA SHARMA: 
  
            Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state : 
 (a)  whether any plan is under the consideration of Government to develop cold chain capacity based on 
present and future requirements; 
(b)  if so, the details thereof; 
(c)  whether any steps have been taken by Government  to increase the cold chain capacity in Haryana 
during the last five years; 
(d)  if so, the details thereof; 
(e)  whether any scheme to train youth to operate the cold chain system is being implemented by 
Government; and 
(f)  if so, the number of youth who  have received training during the last three years, state -wise details 
thereof?  
  
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a) & (b):    The Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI ) is implementing a scheme namely 
“Integrated Cold Chain and Value Addition Infrastructure (CCI)” since 2008 for supporting development of 
cold chain infrastructure in the country. This is presently a sub-scheme of ‘Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA 
Yojana (PMK SY)’ and a demand -driven scheme wherein project proposals are invited from interested 
individuals/ entities through Expression of Interest (EoI) floated from time to time by the Ministry. Approvals 
to the proposals received against EoI are accorded by the Ministry on merit basis amongst proposals found 
eligible as per eligibility and assessment criteria stipulated in the scheme guidelines.   MoFPI has so far 
approved 376 such projects across different States/ UTs with project cost of Rs.10713.13 crores, appr oved 
grants-in-aid of Rs.2848.39 crores, processing capacity of 152.18 lakh MT/annum and preservation capacity 
of 31.51 Lakh MT/annum. 
(c) & (d):    Out of the 376 approved projects, 19 are located in Haryana having project cost of Rs.536.40 
crores, approved grants-in-aid of Rs.140.28 crores, processing capacity of 6.39 lakh MT and preservation 
facility of 1.66 lakh MT/annum. 
(e) & (f):   MoFPI is not implementing any scheme for providing support for training on operating cold chain 
system. However, as per information made available by the Sector Skill council, namely FICSI (Food Industry 
Capacity & Skill Initiative), the State/UT -wise and year-wise details of training imparted w.r.t. job roles for

Facility(SA-FMF) is as under:

UNSTARRED QUESTION No. 1075 
ANSWERED ON 10TH FEBRUARY, 2023 
  
‘SETTING UP OF FPI UNDER PMKSY IN GUJARAT’ 
  
1075. SHRI NARHARI AMIN: 
 
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
  
(a)  whether the Government has invited proposals from the State of Gujarat for setting up food 
processing units/industries under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana (PMKSY); 
(b)  if so, the details of the proposals received so far; 
(c)  whether the Government has conducted any study in Gujarat for setting up of FPI, if so, the details 
thereof; and 
(d) the details of assistance provided to entrepreneurs for setting up food processing units in the State 
of Gujarat during each of the last three years? 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a) & (b): The Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MOFPI) is implementing different sub-schemes of 
“Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana (PMKSY)” for extending financial support by way of grants-in-
aid for setting up of food processing facilities. All sub-schemes under PMKSY are demand-driven wherein 
project proposals are invited from interested individuals/ entities from across the countr y, including 
Gujarat, through Expression of Interest (EoI) floated by the Ministry from time to time. Approvals to the 
proposals received are accorded on merit basis amongst proposals found eligible as per eligibility and 
assessment criteria stipulated in the guidelines of the respective sub -schemes. The last such EoI was 
floated on 21st June 2022. A total of 273 application have been received from individuals/ entities under 
different sub-schemes of PMKSY so far with proposals to set up food processing facilities in Gujarat, out 
of which approvals were accorded to 81 eligible projects. 
 
(c):    Study to identify gaps in infrastructure for processing of Banana, Mango and Pomegranate in 
production clusters located in Gujarat were conducted during 2021-22. The major gaps so identified were 
notified along with the EoI issued on 21st June 2022 inviting project proposals. Weightage in assessment 
criteria was also announced for those applicants who propose to set up projects in these production 
clusters. One project each in Vadodara and Kachchh districts have been approved recently for processing 
of Banana and Pomegranate respectively.   
 
(d):     Rs.80.73 crores in 2019-20; Rs.65.29 crores in 2020-21; Rs.52.88 crores in 2021-22; and Rs.43.12 
crores in 2022 -23 (till 31.01.2023) have been released as grants -in-aid against the approved pro jects 
located in Gujarat.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF HEAVY INDUSTRIES  
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 1077 
ANSWERED ON 10.02.2023 
 
SUBSIDY FOR TWO WHEELER EVs  
 
1077. SHRI JAWHAR SIRCAR:  
 
Will the Minister of Heavy Industries be pleased to state:  
 
(a) whether it is a fact that the Parliamentary Standing Committee of Industry has recommended 
to Government to release the subsidies withheld also to indigenous electric vehicle 
manufacturers;  
(b) whether it is also a fact that there has been misuse of Government funds, if so, the details 
thereof; and  
(c) the steps taken by Government to resolve the issues and improve production of electric 
vehicles in the country? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR HEAVY INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI KRISHAN PAL GURJAR) 
 
(a):  No Sir.  No such recommendation has been received in the Ministry of Heavy Industries from 
Parliamentary Standing Committee of Industry. 
 
(b) & (c):  Yes, Sir. The Ministry has received complaints regarding misappropriation of 
subsidies under the Government’s FAME India Phase II  scheme by some electric vehicles 
manufacturers. The complaints are mainly related to the violation of Phased Manufacturing 
Programme (PMP) guidelines under FAME India Scheme Phase -II.  All the complaint cases have 
been referred to the testing agencies for re -verification.  After examination of reports in respect of 
two OEMs, the models of these two OEMs have been suspended from t he FAME scheme.  Further, 
the processing of their pending claims has been stopped till they submit sufficient evidence to show 
their compliance to PMP timelines. 
 
Further, following steps have been taken by the Government to improve production of 
electric vehicles in the country: - 
i. The demand incentive for electric two wheelers has been increased to Rs. 15,000/KWh from 
Rs. 10,000/KWh along with an increase in cap from 20% to 40% of the cost of electric vehicle 
with effect from 11th June, 2021. 
ii. The Government on 12 th May, 2021 approved a Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme 
for manufacturing of Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) in the country which will lead to 
lowering the prices of battery in the country along with a consequent drop in the cost of 
electric vehicles.  Further, the PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component was notified 
on 23rd September, 2021 also has the provision for incentivizing Electric Vehicles. 
iii. GST on electric vehicles has been reduced from 12% to 5%; GST on chargers/ chargi ng 
stations for electric vehicles has been reduced from 18% to 5%. 
iv. Keeping in view the need for promoting electric mobility and alternate fuels, the Ministry of 
Road Transport and Highways, vide notification issued on October 18, 2018, has exempted 
Battery Operated Vehicles, from the requirement of permit for carrying passengers or goods.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF HEAVY INDUSTRIES  
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 1080 
ANSWERED ON 10.02.2023 
 
FINANCIAL AND REGULATORY SUPPORT TO HEAVY INDUSTRIES 
 
1080. SHRI JUGALSINH LOKHANDWALA:  
 
Will the Minister of Heavy Industries be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether any Production Linked Incentives (PLIs) are being provided by the Ministry, if so, 
the details thereof;  
(b) whether the Ministry has issued any guidelines to industries in respect of increasing domestic 
manufacturing under "Make in India" initiative; and  
(c) whether any financial and regulatory support to heavy industries is envisioned for the next 
fiscal year 2023-24? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR HEAVY INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI KRISHAN PAL GURJAR) 
 
(a): Yes Sir, this Ministry has launched two (02) Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Schemes, 
namely PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry, and PLI Scheme for National 
Programme on Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage. 
 
(i) PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry:- With the aim to boost 
India’s manufacturing capabilities in the automobile and the auto components sector, government 
approved a PLI Scheme namely ‘PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry’ for this 
sector with a total budgetary outlay of Rs. 25,938 crores over a period of 5 years (FY 2022-23 to FY 
2026-27).  Total expected employment generation and total expected cumulative increase in eligible 
sales are 1.45 Lakh (Direct employment) and ₹2,31,500 Crore, respectively over a period of 5 years. 
The details of this scheme may be seen at https://heavyindustries.gov.in/UserView/index?mid=2482 
 
(ii) PLI Scheme for National Programme on Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery 
Storage:- To enhance India’s manufacturing capabilities for manufacture of Advance Chemistry Cell 
(ACC) in India, government approved a PLI Scheme for setting up manufacturing facilities for 
Advance Chemistry Cell (ACC), Battery Storage in India, with an outlay of Rs. 18,100 crores for 7 
years (including two years of gestation period).  Total estimated investment to be made by the 
beneficiary firms is to the tune of Rs. 27,000 crore.  The scheme will generate employment of 2.7 
lakhs.  The details of this scheme may be seen at 
https://heavyindustries.gov.in/UserView/index?mid=2487   
 
(b): With the vision of  AatmaNirbhar Bharat and to make India as a self-reliant nation, MHI has 
launched PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry, and PLI Scheme for National 
Programme on Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage with the objective of Domestic 
Value Addition (DVA) in the products manufactured in India.  In PLI Auto, minimum 50% DVA will 
be required to get the incentive.  In PLI ACC scheme, the beneficiary firms are required to achieve a 
minimum of 25% DVA by end of 2nd Year and 60% by the end of 5th Year of the scheme. 
 
(c): As on date, no financial and regulatory support to heavy industries is envisioned for next fiscal 
year 2023-24.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA

RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 1081 
ANSWERED ON 10.02.2023 
 
CLEAN ENERGY 
 
 
 1081. SHRI DEREK O’BRIEN: 
 
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether the Railways plan to achieve carbon neutrality by 2030, if so, the details 
thereof; 
 
(b)    the progress that has been made on this target, details thereof; 
 
(c) whether it is a fact that by 2029-30, the expected requirement of installation of 
renewable capacity would be about 30 gigawatts; and 
 
(d) If so, the percentage of this capacity that has been installed so far? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND  
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
 
(a) to (d) Indian Railways has set a target of becoming Net Zero Carbon Emitter by 2030. IR 
has taken a number of initiatives to reduce its carbon emissions which include use of energy 
efficient technologies like completely switching over to production of three phase electric 
locomotives with regenerative features, use of head on generation (HOG) technology, use of 
LED lights in buildings and coaches, star rated appliances, water conservation and 
management, afforestation, bio toilets on coaches and waste management. The key strategies 
that have been identified for achieving the Net Zero Carbon emission target are procurement 
of power through renewable energy sources; shifting from diesel to electric traction; 
promotion of energy efficiency; and afforestation. 
 
To achieve Net Zero Carbon Emission, expected requirement of renewable capacity by 2029-
30 would be about 30,000 MW. As of January 2023, about 145 Mega Watt (MW) of solar 
plants (both on Rooftops and on land) and about 103 MW of Wind power plants have been 
commissioned. Further, about 2150 MW of renewable capacity has also been tied up. 
 
In addition, IR has planned to progressively procure renewable energy from different power 
procurement modes for its future energy requirements.

425

 
STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (c) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO. 1083 BY SHRI MUKUL BALKRISHNA WASNIK  ANSWERED IN RAJYA 
SABHA ON 10.02.2023 REGARDING RATLAM-DUNGARPUR-BANSWARA RAILWAY 
LINE 
 
(a) to (c): Ratlam-Dungarpur via Banswara (188 Km) new line project was sanctioned on 2011-12 
with the proviso to share 50% of the final construction cost of the project and providing land free 
of cost by the State Government of Rajasthan. 
 
The total requirement of land for the project is 1736 Hectares, out of which, Government 
of Rajasthan has acquired only 646 Hectares land so far and deposited only ₹ 200 crores as a part 
of construction cost of the project.  Government of Rajasthan has refused to share 50% revised 
cost of the project and requested that the entire construction cost should be borne by Railways.  
  Since Government of Rajasthan has neither provided the total land required for the 
project nor deposited their share to Railways as per the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), 
the project is presently held up on account of the same.  
  Further, on the request of Government of Rajasthan, Bankability study of project was 
completed and as per report, the cost of the project (excluding the cost of the land) has been 
assessed as ₹ 4262.35 crore with the Rate of Return as (+) 2.73 %.  Since, this cost is without 
considering the cost of land, hence, if the cost of the complete land for setting up of this project is 
aslso included then the Rate of Return of the project will be further reduced.  
  Government of Rajasthan has been requested that to make the project viable.  
Government of Rajasthan can consider providing land free of cost.  However, Government of 
Rajasthan has not agreed for providing land free of cost.  Project is held up on this account.

Completion of any Railway project/s depends on various factors like quick land acquisition by State 
Government, forest clearance by officials of forest department, shifting of infringing utilities, 
statutory clearances from various authorities, geological and topographical conditions of area, law 
and order situation in the area of project/s site, number of working months in a year for particular 
project/s site etc.  All these factors affect the completion time of the project/s.  With above 
constraints, Railway is making all effort for expeditious completion of project/s.  
 
Since 2014, there has been substantial increase in budget allocation and commensurate 
commissioning of infrastructure projects.  
Average annual budget allocation for infrastructure projects and safety works, falling fully/partly in 
the State of Andhra Pradesh, during 2014-19 has increased to ₹2830 crore  per year from ₹886 crore 
per year during 2009-14. Thus, an increase of 219% over the average annual budget allocation 
of 
2009-14. Budget outlay for these projects has bee n increa sed to ₹3885 crore in 2019 -20 (338% 
more than average annual budget outlay during 2009- 14), ₹4910 crore in 2020-21 (454% more than 
average annual budget  outlay during 2009- 14) and ₹6223 crore in financial year 2021 -22 (602% 
more than average annual outlay during 2009-14).  For financial year 2022-23 the highest ever 
budget allocation of ₹7,032 crore has been provided for these projects, which is 694% more than the 
average of 2009-14 (₹ 886 Cr/Yr.). 
 
During 2014-22, 989 Km sections (350 km of New line and 639 km of Doubling) falling 
fully/partly in Andhra Pradesh have been commissioned at an average rate of 123.63 km per year, 
which is 70% more commissioning than during 2009-14( 72.6 Km/Yr.) in undivided Andhra 
Pradesh.

Amrit Bharat Station scheme envisages development of stations on a continuous basis with a long 
term approach.  It involves preparation of Master Plans and their implementation in phases to 
improve the amenities at the stations like improvement of station access, circulating areas, waiting 
halls, toilets, lift/escalators as necessary, cleanliness, free Wi-Fi, kiosks for local products through 
schemes like ‘One Station One Product’, better passenger information systems, Executive Lounges, 
nominated spaces for business meetings, landscaping etc. keeping in view the necessity at each 
station.  
 
 
The scheme also envisages improvement of building, integrating the station with both sides of the 
city, multimodal integration, amenities for Divyangjans, sustainable and environment friendly 
solutions, provision of ballastless tracks, ‘Roof Plazas’ as per necessity, phasing and feasibility and 
creation of city centres at the station in the long term. 
 
(c) Development/redevelopment/upgradation of Railway Stations is complex in nature involving 
safety of passengers and trains and requires various statutory clearances from urban/local bodies 
etc. and these factors affect the completion time. Therefore, no time frame can be indicated.

Railway Infrastructure Projects in the State of West Bengal is covered by Eastern Railway (ER), 
South Eastern Railway (SER) and Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) Zones of Indian Railways.  
The project-wise details including cost, expenditure and outlay are available in public domain on

Completion of any Railway project/s depends on various factors like quick land acquisition by State 
Government, forestry clearance by officials of forest department, shifting of infringing utilities, 
statutory clearances from various authorities, geological and topographical conditions of area, law 
and order situation in the area of project/s site, number of working months in a year for particular 
project site due to climatic conditions, etc. With above constraints, every effort is being made to 
complete these projects at the earliest.  
438

Since 2014, there has been substantial increase in allocation of funds and commensurate 
commissioning of Infrastructure projects. Average Annual Budget allocation for Infrastructure 
projects & safety works, falling fully/ partly in State of West Bengal, during 2014-19 has been 
enhanced to ₹4,612 crore per year from  ₹4,380 crore per year during 2009 -14, which is 5% more 
than Average Annual Budget allocation during 2009-14. These 
allocations 
have been increased to ₹5,033 crore i n Financial Year 2019-20 (15% more than the 
Average Annual Budget allocation of 2009- 14), ₹5,246 crore in Financial Year 2020 -21 (20% more 
than the Average Annual Budget allocation of 2009-14) and ₹6,988 crore in Financial Year 2021 -22 
(60% more than the Average Annual Budget Outlay of 2009-14). For Financial Year 2022-23, 
highest ever Budget outlay of ₹10,262 crore has been provided for these projects, which is 134% 
more than the Average Annual Budget Outlay of 2009-14 (₹4,380 crore per year).  
 
During 2014-22, 998 km sections (88 km new line, 151 km Gauge conversion and 759 km doubling) 
falling fully/partly in the state of West Bengal have been commissioned at an average rate 124.75 
km per year. 
 
Various steps being taken by the Government for effective and speedy implementation of rail 
projects include (i) setting up of Gati Shakti Directorate in the Ministry and Gati Shakti units in 
field, (ii) prioritisation of projects, (iii) substantial increase in allocation of funds, (iv) delegation of 
powers at field level, (v) close monitoring of progress of project at various levels (vi) regular follow 
up with State Governments and concerned authorities for expeditious land acquisition, forestry and 
Wildlife clearances and for resolving other issues pertaining to projects.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (c) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO. 1091 BY DR. ANIL SUKHDEORAO BONDE ANSWERED IN RAJYA 
SABHA ON 10.02.2023 REGARDING IMPROVEMENT OF RAILWAY STATIONS. 
(a) and (b)  The Amrit Bharat Station Scheme has recently been launched for development of 
Railway stations on Indian Railways. This scheme envisages development of stations on a 
continuous basis with a long-term approach.  
It involves preparation of Master Plans and their implementation in phases to improve 
the amenities at the stations like improvement of station access, circulating areas, waiting 
halls, toilets, lift/escalators as necessary, cleanliness, free Wi-Fi, kiosks for local products 
through schemes lik e ‘One Station One Product’, better passenger information systems, 
Executive Lounges, nominated spaces for business meetings, landscaping etc.  keeping in 
view the necessity at each such station.   
The scheme also envisages improvement of building, integrating the station with both 
sides of the city, multimodal integration, amenities for Divyangjans, sustainable and 
environment friendly solutions, provision of ballast less tracks, ‘Roof Plazas’ as per necessity, 
phasing and feasibility and creation of city centres at the station in the long term.  
Presently, the scheme envisages to take-up 1275 stations for 
upgradation/modernisation over Indian Railway.  The list of state-wise stations identified to 
be taken up under the Amrit Bharat Station Scheme is appended.  
(c) The details of allocation of funds and expenditure for development and maintenance of 
stations are maintained zonal Railway-wise and not work-wise or Station-wise. The details of 
funds allocated by Indian Railway for development and maintenance of 
stations under Plan  
Head-53 ‘Customer Amenities’, for the last year and the current year are as under: -

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (c) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO.1092 BY MS. INDU BALA GOSWAMI ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 
10.02.2023 REGARDING AMRIT BHARAT STATION SCHEME 
  
(a) to 
(c) Amrit Bharat Station Scheme has recently been launched for development of Railway 
stations on Indian Railways. This scheme envisages development of stations on a continuous basis 
with a long-term approach. 
 
It involves preparation of Master Plans and their implementation in phases to improve the amenities 
at the stations like improvement of station access, circulating areas, waiting halls, toilets, 
lift/escalators as necessary, cleanliness, free Wi-Fi, kiosks for local products through schemes like 
‘One Station One Product’, better passenger information systems, Executive Lounges, nominated 
spaces for business meetings, landscaping etc. keeping in view the necessity at each station.   
 
The scheme also envisages improvement of building, integrating the station with both sides of the 
city, multimodal integration, amenities for Divyangjans, sustainable and environment friendly 
solutions, provision of ballastless tracks, ‘Roof Plazas’ as per necessity, phasing and feasibility and 
creation of city centres at the station in the long term. 
 
1275 stations have been selected based on the proposals received from Zonal Railways, stations 
located in major cities and towns.

    GOVERNMENT OF INDIA

RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO.1097 
 ANSWERED ON 10.02.2023 
 
TRAINS TO AND FROM KERALA 
    
 1097 SHRI A. A. RAHIM: 
 
            Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) number of trains from Kerala to each of the metro cities in India including Bengaluru, 
Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai and Delhi; 
 
(b) on an average, how early do tickets in each class of these trains have to be booked to be 
available as confirmed and not waitlist; 
 
(c) whether Railways propose to increase the number of trains to and from Kerala; 
 
(d) if so, the details including destination, number of trains and by when the new trains will be 
launched; and 
 
(e) if not, the plans of Railways to meet huge demand of tickets to and from 
Kerala? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND      
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
  
(a) to (e) Indian Railways (IR) do not run train services on State- wise basis as Railway network 
straddles across State boundaries. However, cities like Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, 
Mumbai and Delhi are presently connected well with various stations (including  
Thiruvananthapuram, Kochuveli, Kannur, Ernakulam, Alappuzha), located in the State of 
Kerala by 12 pairs, 21 pairs, 2 pairs, 27 pairs and 13 pairs of train services respectively.  
On IR, the demand for reserved accommodation is not uniform and varies during lean and peak 
periods. During peak periods, like summer vacations, pooja rush, Diwali/Chhath, winter 
vacation/Holi, etc., when demand exceeds the availability, the reserved accommodation, 
especially in higher class gets booked within a very short duration of opening of reservation 
whereas during lean periods, the accommodation remains available for comparatively longer 
duration. To meet the requirement of travelling passengers during peak periods, IR, subject to 
operational feasibility, traffic demand, availability of resources etc., operates special trains and 
augments the load of existing trains on temporary basis. Besides, introduction of new train 
services is an ongoing process.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) AND (b ) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO. 1098 BY DR. C.M. RAMESH ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 
10.02.2023 REGARDING RAILWAY PROJECTS UNDER CONSTRUCTION IN 
DIFFERENT STATES 
 
(a) & (b): The Railway Infrastructure projects are sanctioned/executed Zonal Railway wise and 
not State-wise/UT wise 
as the Railways’ projects may span across State boundaries.  
 
As on 01.04.2022, across Indian Railways, 452 Railway Infrastructure Projects (183 New Line, 
42 Gauge Conversion and 227 Doubling) of total length 49,323
 Km, costing approx. `7.33 lakh 
crore are in different stages of planning/sanction/execution, out of which, 11,518 Km length has 
been commissioned and an expenditure of approx. `2.35 lakh crore has been incurred upto 
March, 2022. 
 
Zone-wise details of Railway Projects including cost, expenditure and outlay are made available 
in public domain on Indian Railways website i.e.  www.indianrailways.gov.in> Ministry of 
Railways> Railway Board> about Indian Railways> Railway Board Directorates> Finance 
(Budget)> Rail Budget/Pink Book (year)> Railway-wise Works, Machinery and Rolling Stock 
Programme (RSP). 
 
The completion of any Railway project(s) depends on various factors like quick land acquisition 
by State Government, forest clearance by officials of forest department, deposition of cost share 
by State Government in cost sharing projects, shifting of infringing utilities, statutory clearances 
from various authorities, geological and topographical conditions of area, law and order situation 
in the area of project(s) site, number of working months in a year for particular project site due to 
climatic conditions etc. and all these factors affect the completion time and cost of the project(s), 
with above constraints, every effort is being made to execute the project(s) expeditiously.  
 
Since 2014, there has been substantial increase in fund allocation for New Line, Gauge 
Conversion and Doubling Projects and commensurate commissioning of Projects in Indian 
Railways. The Average Annual Budget allocation for New Line, Gauge Conversion and Doubling 
Projects across Indian Railways during 2014-19 increased to `26,026 crore per year from `11,527 
crore per year during 2009-14 (126% more than average annual budget allocation during 2009-
14). The Annual Budget allocation increased to `39,836 crore in Financial Year 2019-20 (246% 
more  than  average  annual  budget  allocation during 2009-14),  `43,626 crore  in Financial Year 
 
..P/2 
459

-:2:- 
2020-21 (278% more than the Average Annual Budget allocation during 2009-14) and `56,716 
crore for Financial year 2021-22 (392% more than average annual budget allocation during 2009-
14). For Financial Year 2022-23, highest-ever budget outlay of `67,001 crore has been provided 
for these works, which is 481% more than average annual budget outlay of 2009-14. 
  
During 2014 -22, across Indian Railway, 20,628 km sections (3,970 km New Line, 5,507 km 
Gauge Conversion and 11,151 km Doubling) has been commissioned at an average of 2,579 
km/year which is 70% more than the average commissioning during 2009-14 (1,520 km/year).

REHABILITATION SCHEME FOR HALDWANI EVICTION FAMILIES 
 
1108 SMT. RAJANI ASHOKRAO PATIL: 
         SHRI
 SYED NASIR HUSSAIN:  
         DR. AMEE YAJNIK: 
 
Will t
he Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government has ensured the displacing families from Railway land, any 
rehabilitation schemes and measures in favour of the affected families, while taking cognizance 
of the humanitarian aspect of the issue;  
(b) the steps taken by Government to clarify the policy of the ownership of disputed land;  
(c) the steps Government will take with regard to the schools, banks, religious sites, and state 
institutions on the railway land, while at the same time declaring its long time occupants as 
‘encroachers’; and  
(d) reasons for eviction despite the legal documentation and generational land holding proof of 
the affected? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND 
 
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
 
(a): Housing is a State Subject and responsibility for providing alternative sites for rehabilitation/ 
resettlement as well as bearing cost for the same, vests with the State Governments or the Urban 
Local Bodies concerned. Section 147 of Railway Act only  provides  for  eviction   of   
unauthorized occupants from railway’s land. 
(b): As per the Authenticated Land Plan of 2003 duly certified by revenue authorities, and as per 
the joint survey report of 2017 conducted by team of Railway, Revenue, and Nagar Nigam 
authorities of the area, the ownership of the land vests with the Railways. 
 
--2/- 
 
477

 
 
..2.. 
 
(c) & (d): Railways carry out eviction process for removal of encroachment of any type on 
railway land. If the encroachments are of temporary nature (soft encroachments) in the shape of 
jhuggies, jhopris and squatters, the same are removed in consultation with and the assistance of 
Railway Protection Force and local civil authorities. For old encroachments, where party is not 
amenable to persuasion, action is taken under Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorized 
Occupants) Act, 1971 (PPE Act, 1971),  as amended from time to time. Actual eviction of 
unauthorized occupants is carried out with the assistance of State Government and police. As the 
area is under encroachment, eviction process was started in compliance of Hon’ble High Court, 
Nainital’s order dated 20.12 .2022. At present, the eviction process has been stopped and the 
matter is subjudice before Hon’ble Supreme Court.

experts was constituted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi.  
The Committee has recommended for provision of medical boxes at all railway stations 
and in passenger carrying trains, mandatory First Aid training for all on board and station staff 
along with provision of medical facility through doctor available on-board (as passenger) or at 
the nearest station.

numbers is available at all Railway Stations. Ambulance services of Railways, State 
Government/Private Hospitals and ambulance service providers are utilized to transport the 
injured/sick passengers to the hospitals/doctor’s clinics.

482

 
 
 
STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (d
) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO.1111 BY SHRI JAGGESH ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 10 .02.2023 
REGARDING UPGRADATION AND RENOVATION OF IMPORTANT RAILWAY 
STATIONS 
  
(a) to (c) Yes, sir. Amrit Bharat Station Scheme has recently been launched for development of 
Railway stations on Indian Railways. It envisages development of stations on a continuous basis 
with a long-term approach.  
 
The Scheme involves preparation of Master Plans and their implementation in phases to improve 
the amenities at the stations like improvement of station access, circulating areas, waiting halls, 
toilets, lift/escalators as necessary, cleanliness, free Wi-Fi, kiosks for local products through 
schemes like ‘One Station One Product’, better passenger information systems, Executive Lounges, 
nominated spaces for business meetings, landscaping etc. keeping in view the necessity at each such 
station.  
 
 
The scheme also envisages improvement of building, integrating the station with both sides of the 
city, multimodal integration, amenities for Divyangjans, sustainable and environment friendly 
solutions, provision of ballastless tracks, ‘Roof Plazas’ as per necessity, phasing and feasibility and 
creation of city centres at the station in the long term. 
 
1275 stations have been selected based on the proposals received from Zonal Railways, stations 
located in major cities and towns. It also includes the stations previously identified for 
redevelopment. 
 
(d) Development/redevelopment/upgradation of Railway Stations is complex in nature involving 
safety of passengers and trains and requires various statutory clearances from urban/local bodies 
etc. and these factors affect the completion time. Therefore, no time frame can be indicated.

REVIVAL OF CLOSED TEXTILE INDUSTRIES 
 
1112. DR. KANIMOZHI NVN SOMU: 
 
 
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:  
 
 
(a) whether Government is considering to revive the closed textiles industries that have remained closed since  
many years;  
 
(b) if so, the time by when they are likely to be revived;  
 
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;  
 
(d) 
whether such mills are likely to be included in the schemes that are being run for the welfare of weavers   
in Tamil Nadu;  
 
(e) if so, the time by when these are likely to be included; and  
 
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?  
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE M
INISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
(a) to (c): There is no specific scheme for the revival of the closed textiles mills across the country. 
However, to this objective, the Government is continuously working to create a conducive policy environment 
and to facilitate creation of enabling conditions for the industry and private entrepreneurs to set -up 
manufacturing units.  For the purpose of assisting entrepreneurs to set -up textile units, the Government is 
implementing various prog rammes/schemes including the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme, 
Pradhan Mantri Mega Integrated Textile Region & Apparel Parks (PM -MITRA) Scheme, 
Integrated Processing Development Scheme (IPDS) and Textile Cluster Development Scheme (TCDS).   
 
(d) to (f): The maximum number of such closed mills are under private sector and the State Government.  
As regards mills under National Textile Corporation (NTC), in the light of continued poor economic viability 
of NTC Mills, Ministry of Textiles is preparing a n action plan for the way forward in the matter in 
consultation with NITI Aayog and Department of Public enterprises, Ministry of Finance. 
 
For development of handlooms and welfare of handloom weavers across the country including Tamil 
Nadu, the Government  of India, Ministry of Textiles is implementing National Handloom Development 
Programme and Raw Material Supply Scheme. Under these schemes, financial assistance is provided to the 
eligible handloom agencies/ weavers for raw materials, looms & accessories,  infrastructure development, 
design & product development, marketing of handloom products in domestic/overseas markets, Weavers 
MUDRA Loans etc.

(b) whether selling of raw cotton has dropped from Rs.10,000-Rs.15,000 per/Kg to 9,000 per/Kg, the reasons  
for such decrease;  
 
(c) the impact of such drop in selling price in the overall income of cotton farmers across India; and  
 
(d) whether there has been a delay in the sowing and harvesting of cotton across the country, if so, details   
thereof, State-wise?  
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
 
(a):   The current average lint prices of S-6 variety of Gujarat (which is most preferred in export) are ruling at 
Rs. 64,600 per candy in comparison to International prices ruling at Rs. 65,600 per candy as measured by 
Cotlook A.  Further, after imposition of 11% import duty the International prices will be Rs. 72,800 per candy 
which is 13% higher than present domestic cotton price. 
 
(b):   The prices of long staple variety (30 mm) cotton, which were ruling in the range of Rs. 8,000 per quintal 
to Rs. 9,000 per quintal are now ruling in the range of Rs. 7,900 to Rs. 8,000 per quintal. The increase and 
decrease in cotton prices mainly depend on demand & supply situation. During previous cotton season, cotton 
prices were higher due to lesser cotton production owing to damage of crops by pest attacks and untimely 
rains in some states. 
(c):   For sustaining the interests of cotton farmers, MSP is fixed by the Government of India to ensure 
reasonably fair remuneration i.e. at least 50% over cost of production to farmers. MSP of cotton for current 
cotton season is higher by around 6% i.e. Rs. 6,380 per quintal in comparison to Rs. 6,025 per quintal during 
last cotton season 2021-22.  During current cotton season farmers are getting 25% to 30% higher market rates 
as compared to MSP rates. 
(d):   
No delay in sowing and harvesting of cotton reported by the states of Haryana, Maharashtra, Gujarat, 
Madhya Pradesh, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Odisha. Punjab State has reported slight delay 
in sowing in districts Sri Muktsar Sahib & Fazlika approximately in 10,000 hectare area.  However, there is 
no delay in harvesting of cotton crop.  Additionally, Rajasthan State has reported that approximately 1,50,000 
hectare is late sown due to late availability of canal water but harvesting and picking is on time.

MANUFACTURING OF TRADITIONAL CLOTHES 
 
1118.  MS. SAROJ PANDEY: 
 
 
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:

the country and their promotion in the country as well as abroad;  
 
(b) if so, the details thereof; and  
 
(c) the financial expenditure incurred thereunder so far?  
 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
(a) & (b): Ministry of Textiles, Office of the Development Commissioner for Handlooms is 
implementing following schemes for manufacturing of traditional textiles of handlooms and their promotion 
in the country as well as abroad: - 
 
 1. National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP) 
 2. Raw Material Supply Scheme (RMSS) 
 
Under the above schemes, financial assistance is provided to the eligible handloom agencies/ weavers 
for raw materials, looms & accessories, infrastructure development, design & product development, 
marketing of handloom products in domestic as well as in overseas markets, weavers MUDRA loans etc.  
  
Traditional handloom products are also promoted by registering them under Geographical Indication 
(GI) Act, 1999. So far, 72 handloom products and 06 product logos are registered under GI Act.   
 
(c): A total expenditure of Rs. 988.33 crore has been incurred under the above schemes during last three 
years and 2022-23 (as on 07.02.2023).

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA

RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO-1120 
ANSWERED ON- 10/02/2023 
 
 
GLOBAL MARKET FOR INDIAN COTTON BASED INDUSTRIES 
 
1120. SHRI M. MOHAMED ABDULLA: 
 
 
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:  
 
 
(a) whether Government is aware about the fact that the Xinjiang cotton ban by the United States of America   
has opened up huge global market for Indian cotton-based products; and  
 
(b) if so, details of the new initiatives to be undertaken by Government to increase the exports of textile   
products? 
 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
(a) & (b): The Government has taken several initiatives/ measures to enhance exports of textile products. 
These include measures to improve access to raw material, support manufacturing across value chain, 
augment capacity across fibres, employment and export facilitation by better market access vis-à-vis 
competitors etc. Some of the major measures are indicated as below: 
 
i. Free Trade Agreements have been signed with UAE and Australia to access export market, 
which came into force from 01.05.2022 and 29.12.2022 respectively. 
ii. To compete with top exporting countries and to position India on global textile map, Schemes 
like the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme, PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and 
Apparel (PM MITRA),Scheme for Integrated Textile Park (SITP), Scheme For Capacity 
Building in Textile Sector (SAMARTH) are implemented by this Ministry. 
iii. In order to address the issues in Textile Value chain through Consultative process, Government 
of India has constituted Textile Advisory Group (TAG) to deliberate and to recommend issues 
pertaining to entire cotton value chain. 
iv.  In order to boost export of textiles products, Government extended continuation of Rebate of 
State and Central Taxes and Levies (RoSCTL) on exports of Apparel/Garments and Made-ups. 
Further, textiles products not covered under the RoSCTL are covered under Remission of 
Duties and Taxes on Exported Products (RoDTEP) along with other products.

अनुबंर्-I 
किनांक  10.02.2023 को  उत््‍तर किए जाने के  णलए  णनयत राज्य सभा तारांककत  प्रश्‍न संख््‍या 105 के  
भाग (क ) और  (ख) के  उत््‍तर में उणल्लणखत अनुबंर् 
 
किल्ली मुबंई औद्योणगक कॉररडोर  (डीएमआईसी) पररयोजना  सणहत आठ णनवेश  क्षेत्रों णजनको  एनआईएमजेड के  रूप  
में सैद्ांणतक अनुमोिन प्रिान कर  किया गया, उनका  ब्यौरा णनम्नवत है: 
 
क्रं.सं. णनवेश  क्षेत्र का  नाम णथिणत 
i. अहमिाबाि- र्ोलेरा णनवेश क्षेत्र (डीएसआईआर), 
गुजरात

किषय: पीएमएफबीिाई िे माध्यम से किसान ां िी आय िा स्थिरीिरण 
962. श्री मुजीबुल्ला खान :  
क्या ि ृ कष एिां किसान  िल्याण मंत्री यह बताने  की क ृ पा कर ें गे षक: 
(क) क्या प्राक ृ षतक आपदाओं के कारण फसलों की नुकसान/क्षषत की स्थर्षत में षकसानों 
को षवत्तीय सहायता  उपलब्ध कराने के उदे े् श्य से शुरू  की गई प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा 
योजना (पीएमएफबीवाई) फसल बीमा के माध्यम से षकसानों की आय के स्थर्रीकरण के 
अपने षवषशष्ट लक्ष्य को पूरा कर रही है;  
(ख) यषद हां, तो  षवत्त विथ 2022-23 में ओषिशा राज्य के लाभाषर्थयों की क ु ल संख्या के 
ब्यौर े सषहत  तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है; और 
(ग) क्या योजना के सुचारू  रूप  से कायाथन्वयन में आने वाली षवसंगषतयों  को द ू र करने के 
षलए कोई षवशेि कदम उठाए जा रहे है, यषद हां, तो  तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है?  
 
उत्‍तर  
ि ृ कष एिां किसान  िल्‍याण मांत्री (श्री नरेन्‍द्र कसांह त मर ) 
 
(क) एवं (ख): देश में खरीफ 2016 सीजन से शुरू  की गई प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा 
योजना (पीएमएफबीवाई) राज्यों और षकसानों के षलए स्वैस्िक है। इस स्कीम के तहत  
षकसानों के षलए न्यूनतम प्रीषमयम पर फसलों के बुवाई पूवथ से लेकर फसलोपंरात  चरणों 
तक  के सभी गैर-षनवायथ प्राक ृ षतक जोस्खमों के एवज में षकसानों की फसलों के षलए व्यापक 
जोस्खम कवर े ज प्रदान षकया जाता  है। पीएमएफबीवाई षवशेि रूप  से प्राक ृ षतक आपदा 
प्रभाषवत मौसमों/विों/क्षेत्रों में षकसानों की आय को स्थर्र करने के षलए षवत्तीय सहायता  
सषहत  स्कीम के उद्देश्यों को सफलतापूवथक पूरा कर रही है। विथ 2016-17 में स्कीम की 
शुरुआत  से लेकर विथ 2021-22 तक , षकसानों द्वारा भुगतान  षकए गए 25,174 करोड़ 
रुपये  के प्रीषमयम के एवज में लगभग 12.38 करोड़ षकसान आवेदनों के षलए 1,30,185 
करोड़ रूपए  की दावा राषश का भुगतान  षकया गया है। 
 
षदनांक 31.01.2023 तक  के उपलब्ध आंकड़ों के अनुसार, पीएमएफबीवाई के तहत  
ओषिशा में खरीफ 2021 के दौरान लगभग 79.2 लाख षकसान-आवेदन दजथ षकए गए हैं।

(ग): षहतधारकों  के परामशथ से इस स्कीम की, षवशेि रूप  से इसक े पररचालन कायाथन्वयन 
में आने वाली चुनौषतयों  का समाधान करने के षलए षनयषमत  रूप  से समीक्षा की जाती  है। 
तदनुसार , षवषभन्न षहतधारकों  के सार् षवस्तृत चचाथ के बाद, स्कीम के प्रचालनात्‍मक 
षदशाषनदेशों को क्रमशः रबी 2018 सीजन और खरीफ 2020 सीजन से संशोषधत  और 
पुनोत्थान षकया गया। सभी षकसानों के षलए स्कीम को स्वैस्िक बनाना, सूचना, षशक्षा और 
संचार (आईईसी) गषतषवषधयों  के षलए बीमा क ं पषनयों द्वारा एकषत्रत सकल प्रीषमयम का कम 
से कम 0.5% अषनवायथ उपयोग; प्रौद्योषगकी का गहन उपयोग, पूवोत्तर क्षेत्र में क ें द्र और 
राज्य सरकार  के बीच 50:50 षवत्तीय शेयरर ं ग पैटनथ को बदलकर 90:10 करना, बीमा 
क ं पषनयों से लंबी अवषध यानी 3 विथ का करार ; राज्यों को आवश्यकताओं के अनुसार 
जोस्खम कवर चुनने की स्वतंत्रता; प्रौद्योषगकी का उपयोग आषद जैसे प्रमुख सुधार षकए गए 
हैं।्‍

963. श्री सुिील ि ु मार र्ुप्ता:  
क्या ि ृ कि एवां किसान िल्याण मंत्री यह बताने  की क ृ पा कर ें गे षक: 
(क) क्या सरकार  का प्रधानमंत्री षकसान सम्मान षनषध (पीएम-षकसान) योजना के अन्तगथत 
षकसानों को दी जाने वाली राषि  में बढोत्तरी करने का कोई प्रस्ताव है;  
(ख) यषद हां, तो  तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा कया है; 
(ग ) यषद नही ं, तो  इसक े क्या कारण हैं; और 
(घ) क्या सरकार  द्वारा इस तरह  की सहायता  खेषतहार  मजद ू रों को उपलब्ध कराने की कोई 
योजना है?  
उत्‍तर  
ि ृ कि एवां किसान िल्‍याण मांत्री (श्री नर े न्‍द्र कसांह तोमर ) 
(ि) से (घ): प्रधानमंत्री षकसान सम्मान षनषध (पीएम-षकसान) योजना एक क ें द्रीय क्षेत्र की 
योजना है। पीएम-षकसान उन सभी षकसान पररवारों  को 3 समान षकस्तों में प्रषत विथ 6000 
रुपये  की आय सहायता  प्रदान करता  है, षजनक े पास क ु छ बषहष्करण मानदंडों के अध्‍यधीन 
भू-जोत  के आकार के षनरपेक्ष क ृ षि योग्‍य भू-जोत  है। योजना के तहत  लाभ प्राप्त करने के 
षलए खेती  योग्य भू-जोत  का स्वाषमत्व बुषनयादी मानदंड बना हुआ है। वतथमान  में, पीएम-
षकसान के तहत  6000 रुपये  की मौजूदा सीमा को बढाने का कोई प्रस्ताव नही ं है। षजन 
खेषतहर  मजद ू रों के पास क ृ षि योग्य  भूषम है, वे पीएम-षकसान लाभ के पात्र हैं।

किषय: जहरीले रासायकिि  उिवरि ां िा प्रय ग  
964. श्री कििय दीिू तेंदू लिर :  
क्या ि ृ कष एिां किसाि  िल्याण मंत्री यह बताने  की क ृ पा कर ें गे षक: 
(क) क्या सरकार  को इस बात  की जानकारी  है षक क ृ षि में प्रयोग षकए जा रहे  रासायषनक  
उवथरकों  और  षविैले रासायनों  से उपभोक्ताओं में बहुत  सारी  दीर्थकाषलक स्वास्थ्य संबंधी 
समस्याए ं उत्पन्न हो रही  हैं;  
(ख) क्या सरकार  ने  क ृ षि में इन  हाषनकारक  रासायषनक  उवथरकों  और  षविैले रसायनों  के 
प्रयोग पर  प्रषतबंध लगाने  के षलए कोई व्यवस्र्ा बनाई  है, यषद हां, तो  यह व्यवस्र्ा षकस 
प्रशासषनक षवभाग के अन्तगथत कायथ करती  है और  क्या उसमें दंड का भी कोई प्रावधान 
है;और   
(ग) यषद हां,  तो  तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है और  यषद नही ं, तो  इसक े क्या कारण  हैं?  
 
उत्‍तर  
ि ृ कष एिां किसाि  िल्‍याण मांत्री (श्री िरेन्‍द्र कसांह त मर ) 
 
(क)  से (ग): क ृ षि उत्पादकता खाद्य सुरक्षा के स्तर को सुषनषित  करने  में 
महत्वपूणथ भूषमका षनभाती  है, षजसक े षलए एक महत्वपूणथ आदान  के रूप  में उवथरक  की 
आवश्यकता होती  है। संस्तुत मात्रा में उवथरक  के संतुषलत  एवं षववेकपूणथ प्रयोग से मनुष्य 
के स्वास्थ्य पर  कोई प्रषतक ू ल प्रभाव नही ं पड़ता है। सरकार  का प्रयास रासायषनक  
उवथरकों , जैव उवथरकों  और  स्र्ानीय रूप  से उपलब्ध जैषवक खादों के षववेकपूणथ उपयोग 
को बढावा देना  है। इस उद्देश्य को प्राप्त करने  के षलए, सरकार  षकसानों को मृदा 
परीक्षण आधाररत  उवथरक  उपयोग अनुशंसाए ं प्रदान करने  के षलए राष्ट्र ीय मृदा स्वास्थ्य और  
उवथरता  प्रबंधन पररयोजना  की मृदा स्वास्थ्य काडथ योजना  कायाथन्‍षवत कर  रही  है। सरकारी  
और  षनजी उद्यषमयों सषहत मृदा परीक्षण प्रयोगशालाओं के नेटवक थ के माध्यम से सरकार  
के पास एक प्रभावी षनगरानी  तंत्र है। मृदा स्वास्थ्य काडथ षकसानों को मृदा के स्वास्थ्य और  
इसकी उवथरता  में सुधार  के षलए पोिक तत्वों की उषित खुराक  की षसफाररश  के सार् 
उनकी  मृदा की पोिक स्स्र्षत के बार े में जानकारी  प्रदान करता  है। खरीफ  और  रबी  
मौसम के षलए उवथरकों  के आकलन  हेतु  मृदा स्वास्थ्य काडथ की षसफाररशें  महत्वपूणथ 
मानदंडों  में से एक हैं। 
मृदा स्वास्थ्य काडथ अनुशंसाओं  के आधार  पर  उवथरकों  के संतुषलत  उपयोग पर  प्रदशथन और  
षकसानों को उवथरकों  के उषित और  एकीक ृ त उपयोग पर  प्रषशक्षण दे ना योजना  का अषभन्न 
अंग है। षकसानों के प्रषशक्षण, षकसानों के खेतों  पर  प्रदशथन और  षकसान मेलों के आयोजन  
के षलए राज्य सरकारों  को षवत्तीय सहायता  प्रदान की जाती  है। 
 
विथ 2015 से, कायथक्रम के तहत  लगभग 6.45 लाख प्रदशथन, 93781 षकसान प्रषशक्षण 
और  7425 षकसान मेले आयोषजत/संिाषलत  षकए गए हैं। राज्य/षजला क ृ षि मशीनरी  और  
पंिायतों  के सार्-सार् ग्रामीण स्तर के ग्रामीण षवकास कायथकताथ  जैसे क ृ षि सस्खयां, पासु 
519

सस्खयां षकसानों को उवथरकों  के सही उपयोग के बार े में षशषक्षत करने  में शाषमल हैं। 
आईसीएआर  इस पहलू पर  षकसानों को षशषक्षत करने  के षलए प्रषशक्षण प्रदान करता  है और  
फ्र ं ट लाइन  प्रदशथनों का आयोजन  करता  है। उवथरकों  के इष्ट्तम उपयोग को सुषनषित  करने  
के षलए षकसानों को उवथरक  अनुप्रयोग में प्रौद्योषगकी अर्ाथत ड र ोन आषद का उपयोग करने  के 
षलए भी प्रोत्साषहत षकया जा रहा  है। 
 
कीटनाशक  फसलों को कीटों और  बीमारी  से बिाकर  क ृ षि उत्पादन को बनाए  रखने  में 
महत्वपूणथ भूषमका षनभाते  हैं। क ृ षि उत्पादन और  उत्पादकता की दीर्थकाषलक स्स्र्रता के षलए 
सुरषक्षत और  प्रभावी कीटनाशकों  की उपलब्धता और  क ृ िक समुदाय द्वारा उनका  षववेकपूणथ 
उपयोग महत्वपूणथ है। पंजीकरण  सषमषत कीटनाशक  अषधषनयम, 1968 के प्रावधानों के 
अनुसार  पंजीकरण  प्रदान करते  समय रसायन  षवज्ञान, जैव-प्रभावकाररता, षविाक्तता, पैक े षजंग 
और  प्रसंस्करण के संबंध में मापदंडों, अध्ययन और  डेटा पर  कीटनाशक  का पूणथ मूल्यांकन 
करती  है और  तदनुसार  इसक े सुरषक्षत उपयोग के षलए प्रत्येक कीटनाशक  के षलए लेबल  
और  पत्रक पर  खुराक , फसल, एहषतयाती  उपाय, मारक  आषद के षववरण  को मंजूरी  देती  
है। हालांषक, कीटनाशक  स्वाभाषवक रूप  से जहरीले  होते  हैं और  प्रबंधन और  षवषनयमन  की 
एक सुव्यवस्स्र्त प्रणाली की आवश्यकता होती  है। भारत  में कीटनाशकों /क ृ षमनाशकों  को 
कीटनाशक  अषधषनयम, 1968 और  कीटनाशक  षनयमा वली, 1971 के प्रावधानों के तहत  
षवषनयषमत  षकया जाता  है। वतथमान  में, षवषभन्न राज्य सरकारों  के 11080 अषधकाररयों  और  
क ें द्र सरकार  के 191 अषधकाररयों  को कीटनाशकों  की गुणवत्ता और  इसक े प्रबंधन की जांि 
के षलए कीटनाशक  षनरीक्षक के रूप  में अषधसूषित षकया जाता  है। षकसानों के खेतों  में 
औिक षनरीक्षण नही ं षकया जाता  है क्योंषक अषधषनयम अपने  र्र े लू उद्देश्यों के षलए या 
षकिन गाडथन  के षलए या अपनी  खेती  के तहत  षकसी भी भूषम के संबंध में षकसी भी 
कीटनाशक  के उपयोग की छ ू ट देता  है। 
 
वनस््‍पषत संरक्षण, संगरोध  एवं संग्रह षनदेशालय  के तहत  26 क ें द्रीय एकीक ृ त कीट प्रबंधन 
क ें द्र (सीआईपीएमसी) हैं जो षकसानों को कीटनाशकों  के सुरषक्षत और  षववेकपूणथ उपयोग के 
बार े में जागरूक  करने  के षलए उनक े खेतों  में सवेक्षण करते  हैं और  षवषभन्न प्रषशक्षण

षवकास कायथक्रम और  बीज उपिार  अषभयान) आयोषजत करते  हैं।  षकसानों  को क े वल

लेकर  प्रसंस्करण, प्रमाणन और  षवपणन और  प्रसंस्करण सषहत फसलोपंरात  प्रबंधन में समर्थन

ि ृ कष एिां किसान  िल्‍याण मांत्री (श्री नरेन्‍द्र कसांह त मर ) 
 
(क)  एवं (ख): सरकार  देश में जैषवक खेती  को बढावा देने  के षलए विथ 2015-16 
से परम्परागत क ृ षि षवकास  योजना  (पीक े वीवाई) और पूवोत्तर क्षेत्र में जैषवक मूल्य श्ृंखला 
षवकास षमशन  (एमओवीसीडीएनईआर ) नामक  समषपथत  स्‍कीमों का कायाथन्‍वयन  कर रही है। 
इन  स्‍कीमों के तहत , षकसानों  को मुख्य रूप  से जैषवक उवथरकों सषहत  जैषवक आदानों  का 
उपयोग करक े जैषवक खेती  करने  के षलए प्रोत्साषहत षकया जाता  है और यह स्‍कीम षकसानों  
को उत्पादन से लेकर जैषवक उत्पादों के षवपणन  तक  सहायता  प्रदान करती  हैं। जैषवक 
उवथरकों के ऑन -फामथ उत्पादन और इसक े उपयोग के बार े में षकसानों  को व्यावहाररक 
प्रषशक्षण स्‍कीम का अषभन्न अंग है। षकसानों  को षवषभन्न जैषवक आदानों  के षलए पीक े वीवाई के 
तह त  31000 रुपये /हेक्टेयर/3 विथ और एमओवीसीडीएनईआर  के तहत  32500/हे/3 विथ की

(ख ) क्या प्रधानमंत्री फसल  बीमा  योजना (पीएमएफबीवाई ) और प्रधान मंत्री क ृ षि षसंचाई 
योजना (पीएम क े एस वाई) जैसी योजनाए ं लघु और सीमांत  षकसानों  तक  पहंची हैं और उन्हें 
लाभ पहंचाया है, यषद हां, तो  तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है;  
(ग ) क्या प्रधानमंत्री षकसान  सम्मान षनषध (पीएम  षकसान ) योजना देश में  षकसानों  का  स्तर 
सुधारने में  सफल  रही  है; और 
(घ) यषद हां, तो  तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है और इस  संबंध  में  षवषभन्न राज्ों को  षकतनी -षक तनी  
राषश आवंषित  और षवतररत की  गई  है?  
उत्‍तर  
ि ृ कष एिां किसान िल्‍याण मांत्री (श्री नरेन्‍द्र कसांह त मर ) 
(ि) से (घ): क ृ षि राज् का  षविय है। हालांषक  भारत सरकार क ृ षि को  बढावा देने और 
छोिे और सीमांत  षकसानों  सषहत  षकसानों  के  कल्याण के  षलए उपयुक्त नीषतगत  उपायों, 
बजिीय सहायता  और षवषभन्न योजनाओं और कायथक्रमों के  माध्यम से राज् सरकार के  प्रयासों 
को  पूरा करती है। षकसानों  के  कल्याण के  षलए भारत सरकार की  षवषभन्न योजनाए ं/कायथक्रम 
षनम्नानुसार हैं: 
1. बजट आिांटन में अभूतपूिव िृद्धि 
विथ 2013-14 में , क ृ षि एवं षकसान  कल्याण मंत्रालय (डेयर सषहत ) और मात्‍स्‍षयकी , 
पशुपालन  एवं डेयरी मंत्रालय के  षलए बजि आवंिन क े वल  30223.88 करोड़ रुपये र्ा। 
इसे विथ 2022-23 में  4.59 गुना  से अषधक  बढाकर 138920.93 करोड़ रुपये कर 
षदया गया  है।  
2. पीएम किसान िे माध्यम से किसान ां ि  आय सहायता  
विथ 2019 में  पीए म -षकसान  योजना का  शुभार ं भ – यह 3 समान  षकस्तों में  प्रषत विथ 
6000 रुपये प्रदान करने वाली  एक  आय सहायता  योजना है। अब तक  लगभग  11 करोड़ 
से अषधक  षकसानों  को  2.24 लाख  करोड़ रूपए से अषधक  धनराषश जारी की  गई  है। 
3.  प्रधानमांत्री फसि बीमा य जना  (पीएमएफबीिाई)  
छह विथ – विथ 2016 में  पीएमएफबीवाई  को  षकसानों  के  षलए उच्च प्रीषमयम दरों और 
क ै षपंग  के  कारण बीमा  राषश में  कमी  की  समस्याओं का  समाधान  करने हेतु  शुरू षकया  
गया  र्ा। कायाथन्वयन के  षपछले  6 विों में  – 38 करोड़ षकसान  आवेदकों  को  नामांषकत  
षकया  गया  है और 12.37 करोड़ से अषधक  षकसा न आवेदकों  (अनंषतम ) के  दावे प्राप्त

हए हैं। इस अवषध  के  दौरान षकसानों  द्वारा उनक े प्रीषमयम के  रूप में  लगभग  25,252 
करोड़ रुपये का  भुगतान  षकया  गया  र्ा षजसकी  तुलना  में  उन्हें 1,30,015 करोड़ रुपये 
(अनंषतम ) से अषधक  के  दावों का  भुगतान  षकया  गया  है। इस  प्रकार षकसानों  द्वारा 
भुगतान  षकए  गए  प्रत्येक 100 रुपये के  प्रीषमयम के  षलए, उन्हें दावों के  रूप में  लगभग  
514 रुपये प्राप्त हए हैं। 
 
4. ि ृ कष क्षेत्र िे किए सांस्थागत ऋण 
i. संस्‍र्ागत ऋण की  पहंच को  विथ 2013-14 में  7.3 लाख  करोड़ रुपये से बढाकर 
विथ 2022-23 में  18.5 लाख  करोड़ रुपये करने का  लक्ष्य रखा गया  है।  
ii. क े सीसी  के  माध्यम से अब पशुपालन  और मत्स्य पालन  करने वाले  षकसानों  को  
भी उनकी  अल्पकाषलक कायथशील  पूंजी की  आवश्यकताओं को  पूरा करने के  षलए प्रषत 
विथ 4% ब्याज पर ररयायती संसर्ागत ऋण का  लाभ प्रदान षकया  जाता  है।  
iii. षकसान  क्र े षडि का डथ (क े सीसी ) के  माध्यम से सभी पीएम -षकसान  लाभाषर्थयों 
को  कवर करते हए ररयायती संसर्ागत ऋण प्रदान करने के  षलए फरवरी 2020 से 
एक  षवशेि अषभयान चलाया गया  है। षदनांक  23.12.2022 की  स्‍षर्षत के  अनुसार, 
इस  अषभयान के  षहस्से के  रूप में  4,49,443 करोड़ रुपये की  स्वीक ृ त ऋण सीमा  
के  सार् 387.87 लाख  नए क े सीसी  आवेदनों को  मंजूरी दी गई  है। 
5. न्‍यूनतम  समथवन मूल्‍य (एमएसपी) ि  उत्पादन िागत िा डेढ गुना  तय  िरना  – 
i. सरकार ने विथ 2018-19 से अखखल  भारतीय भाररत औसत  उत्पादन लागत  पर कम  
से कम  50 प्रषतशत के  प्रषतफल के  सार् सभी अषनवायथ खरीफ, रबी और अन्य 
वाषणखज्क फसलों  के  षलए एमएसपी  में  वृखि  की  है।

खव ं िल से बढाकर विथ 2022-23 में  2040 रुपये प्रषत खव ं िल कर षदया गया  है।

6.53 लाख  हेक्टेयर क्षेत्र को  कवर षकया  गया  है षजससे  16.19 लाख  षकसान  
लाभाखन्वत हए हैं। इसक े  अषतररक्त नमाषम  गंगे  कायथक्रम के  अंतगथत  123620 हेक्टेयर 
क्षेत्र कवर षकया  गया  और प्राक ृ षतक खेती  के  अंतगथत  4.09 लाख  हेक्टेयर क्षेत्र कवर 
षकया  गया।  उत्तर प्रद ेश, उत्तराखंड, षबहार और झारखंड के  षकसानों  ने नदी जल

के  दोनों ओर जैषवक  खेती  शुरू की  है। 
ii. सरकार का  भारतीय प्राक ृषतक  क ृ षि पिषत  (बीपीक े पी ) योजना के  माध्यम से

उद्देश्य खेती  की  लागत  में  किौती  करना, षकसानों  की  आय में  वृखि  करना और 
संसाधन  संरक्षण और सुरषक्षत एवं स्वसर् मृदा , पयाथवरण और भोजन सुषनषित  करना 
है।

षकया  गया  है। इसक े  तहत  379 षकसान  उत्पादक क ं पषनयों का  गिन  षकया  गया  है

7. प्रकत बूांद अकधि फसि  
प्रषत बूंद अषधक  फसल  (पीडीएमसी ) योजना विथ 2015-16 में  शुरू की  गई  र्ी षजसका  
उद्देश्य सूक्ष्म षसंचाई  प्रौद्योषगषकयों अर्ाथत षड ि प और खरंकलर षसंचाई प्रणाषलयों के  माध्यम 
से खेत  स्तर पर जल उपयोग  दक्षता में  वृखि  करना और उत्‍पादकता  में  वृखि  करना है। 
विथ 2015-16 से अब तक  पीडीएमसी  योजना के  माध्यम से 69.55 लाख  हेक्टेयर क्षेत्र 
को  सूक्ष्म षसंचाई  के  तहत  कवर षकया  गया  है। 
 
8. सूक्ष्म कसांचाई ि ष

गया  है। विथ 2021-22 की  बजि घोिणा में  इस कोि में  षनषधयों की  मात्रा को  बढाकर 
10000 करोड़ रुपये षकया  जाना है। इसक े  तहत  17.09 लाख  हेक्टेयर क्षेत्रों को  कवर 
करने वाली  4710.96 करोड़ रुपये की  पररयोजनाओं को  मंजूरी दी गई  है।

ii. षदनांक  30.11.2022 तक  की  खसर्षत के  अनुसार, नई एफपीओ योजना के

की  अवषध  के  षलए 500 करोड़ रुपये आवंषित  षकए  गए  हैं। विथ 2020-21 और  2021-

क् या‍िृ वि‍एवां‍किसान‍िल्‍ याण‍मांत्री यह बताने की क ृपा कर ेंगे कक:

केंद्रों की सहायता के शलए किम उठाए हैं, ल्जससे खाद्य के क्षेत्र में अशभनव अन ुप्रयोगों 
के शलए वैल्ववक आिानों में षवषवधता आएगी;  
(ख) यदि हां, तो तत् संबंधी ब् यौरा क् या है और यदि नहीं तो इसके क् या कारण ह ैं;

हैं, खाद्य प्रसंस् करण उद्योग मंत्रालय (एमओएफपीआई) अपनी सेंट्रल सेक् टर अम्‍ब रेला स् कीम

अलावा, प्रोर्क् िन शलंक् र् इंसेंदटव स् कीम फॉर फूर् प्रोसेशसंग इंर्स् ट्री (पीएलआईएसएफपीआई)

व्यन्क्तगत खेनतहर ककसानों को बीमा दावा प्रदान करने का संबंध है , यह योजना सभी बीलमत ककसानों को , उनके खेत के 
आकार या हक का ध्यान रखे बब ना , ओलाव ृन्ष्ट, भूस्खलन, बाढ़, नैसधगथक अन्नन एवं बादल फटने जैसे स्र्ानीय जोखखमों 
और िक्रवाती बाररश, बेमौसम बाररश तर्ा ओलाव ृन्ष्ट के कारण फसलोपरांत न ुकसान का कवरेज प्रदान करती है। पन्‍िम 
बंगाल सरकार रबी 2018-2019 से इस योजना को कायाथन्‍वत नहीं कर रही है।  
प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना (पीएमएफबीवाई) के तहत षपछले तीन विों के ललए बीलमत ककसानों के आवेदनों 
का राज्य-वार और विथ -वार षववरण अन ुबांध-3 में ददया गया है।

धारा 5 के अधीन गहठत रक्जस् री करण ससमनत ने क ृषि में उपयोग के सलए प्रनतजीवी और प्रनतजीषवय पदार्ों के चरणबद्ध समापन की 
यहद कोई षवकल् प  उपलब् ध हो, संभावना की खोज के सलए एक उप -ससमनत गहठत की र्ी , चूंकक क ृषि में इन पदार्ों के सतत प्रयोग से

और केन्‍द रीय सरकार ने उक् त  अधधननयम की धारा 27 की उपधारा ( 2) द्वारा प्रदत् त शक्क् तयों का प्रयोग करते ह ुए उक् त उप-
ससमनत की ससफाररशों पर षवचार करने के पच चा त् और उक् त अधधननयम के अधीन स् र्ा षपत रक्जस् री करण ससमनत से परामशथ करके 
ननम् नसलणखत प्ररूप आदेश तैयार करने का प्रस् ता व ककया है , जो उन सभी व् यक्क् तयों की जानकारी के सलए क्जनकी इससे प्रभाषवत होने 
की संभावना है प्रकासशत ककया जाता है और तदन ुसार यह स ूचना दी जाती है कक उक् त  प्रारूप आदेश पर उस तारीख से क्जसको उक् त

पच चात् षवचार ककया जाएगा ;

(ग )  क्या सरकार  स्टार्ट -अप्स में किदेशी कनिेश के  सोंबोंध में ककसी भी किकनयमन को  आसान  
बनाने  की  योजना  बना  रही  है; और  
(घ)  यकद हाों, तो  तत्सोंबोंधी ब्यौरा क्या है?  
 
उत्तर 
वाणिज्य और  उद्योग मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री सोम प्रकाश) 
 
(क) से (घ): सरकार  ईज ऑफ ड ू इोंग कबजनेस और  अनुपािन  बोझ को  कम  करने  
के  तहत  पहिोों का  नेतृत्व  कर  रही  है कजसका उद्देश्य अनुक ू ि  व्यािसाकयक 
िातािरण  सृकजत  करना  है। इन  पहिोों का  उद्देश्य स्टार्टअप  सकहत अथटव्यिस्था 
की  सभी क ों पकनयोों/क्षेत्ोों/उद्योगोों को  िाभ प्रदान  करना  है। 
पहि  के  मुख्य फोकस  क्षेत् कनम्नानुसार  हैं: 
(i) आिेदन, निीकरण , कनरीक्षण , ररकाडट  प्रस्तुत  करने  आकद से सोंबोंकधत 
प्रकियाओों को  सरि  बनाना , 
(ii)  अनािश्‍यक  कानूनोों को  समाप्त  कर के , सोंशोकधत  कर के  अथिा 
सखिकित करक े  युखिसोंगत बनाना , 
(iii)  ऑनिाइन  इोंर्रफ े स बनाकर  कडकजर् िीकरण  कर ना  कजससे मैनुअि  
फॉमट और  ररकॉडट  की  आिश्यकता  समाप्‍त  कर ना , और   
(iv)  गौण  तकनीकी  अथिा प्रकियागत  चूकोों का  गैर -अपराधीकरण  
करना।    
किशेष रूप  से स्टार्टअप  इकोकसस्टम  के  किए, सरकार  ने  ईज ऑफ ड ू इोंग 
कबजनेस को  बढाने , पूोंजी जुर्ाने  और  अनुपािन  बोझ को  कम  करने  के  किए 
किकभन्न उपाय ककए हैं। इस सोंबोंध में, 31 कदसोंबर 2022 तक , स्टार्टअप

इकोकसस्टम  के  किए ककए गए  53 प्रमुख  कनयामक  सुधारोों की  सूची अनुबंर्-
I में दी गई  है।  
 
किकभन्न किभागोों और  मोंत्ाियोों की  चि  रही  स्कीमोों के  अिािा, सरकार  ने  
भारत  में घर े िू और  किदेशी कनिेश को  बढािा देने  के  किए किकभन्न कदम  उठाए 
हैं। इनमें माि और  सेिा कर  की  शुरूआत  करना , कॉरपोर े र्  करोों में कमी  
करना , कित्तीय बाजार  में सुधार  करना , सािटजकनक  क्षेत् के  बैंकोों का  एकीकरण  
करना , प्रत्यक्ष किदेशी कनिेश (एफडीआई) में नीकतगत  सुधार  करना , अनुपािन  
बोझ को  कम  करना , सािटजकनक  अकधप्राखप्त आदेशोों,चरणबद्ध  किकनमाटण 
कायटिम  के  माध्यम से घर े िू किकनमाटण को  बढािा देने  के  किए किकभन्न नीकतगत  
उपाय शाकमि हैं। देश में प्रत्यक्ष किदेशी कनिेश (एफडीआई) को  बढािा देने  
के  किए, सरकार  ने  कनिेशक  अनुक ू ि  नीकत  तैयार  की  है कजसमें रणनीकतक  
रूप  से महत्वपूणट  क ु छ क्षेत्ोों को  छोड़कर अकधकाोंश क्षेत् स्वतः अनुमोदन  मागट  
के  तहत  100% एफडीआई के  किए खुिे हैं। इसक े अकतररि , प्रत्यक्ष किदेशी 
कनिेश सोंबोंधी नीकत  की  सतत  आधार  पर  समीक्षा की  जाती  है ताकक  यह 
सुकनकित ककया जा सक े कक भारत  कनिेश के  किए आकषटक  और  कनिेशक  
अनुक ू ि  गोंतव्य स्थि बना  रहे।  शीषट  उद्योग चैम्बसट, सोंघोों, क्षेत्गत  
मोंत्ाियोों/किभागोों और  उद्योगोों/समूहोों तथा  अन्य सोंगठनोों के  प्रकतकनकधयोों सकहत 
कहतधारकोों के  साथ किस्तार से किचार -किमशट करने  के  बाद इस नीकत  में 
पररितटन  ककए जाते  हैं। 
इसक े अिािा, सरकार  ने  भारत  में कनिेशकोों, उद्यकमयोों और  व्यिसाकययोों को  
आिश्यक अनुमोदन  और  मोंजूरी की  पहचान  तथा  इन्हें प्राप्त  करने  में सक्षम 
बनाने  के  किए एकि  मोंच प्रदान  करने  हेतु  नेशनि  कसोंगि किोंडो कसस्टम 
(एनएसडब्ल्यूएस) का  शुभार ों भ ककया है। एनएसडब्ल्यूएस किकभन्न 
मोंत्ाियोों/किभागोों से सभी गिनटमेंर् र्ू  कबजनेस (जी2बी) मोंजूररयोों के  किए 
आिेदन करने  के  साथ-साथ एकि  कनिेशक  प्रोफाइि  के  आधार  पर  किकभन्न 
अनुमोदनोों से सोंबोंकधत फामट को  स्वयों भरकर  कायट  के  दोहराि  को  समाप्त  
करने  के  किए कसोंगि इोंर्रफ े स प्रदान  कर  रहा  है।

स्टार्टअप  इकोकसस्टम  हेतु  ककए गए  53 प्रमुख  किकनयामक सुधार  कनम्नानुसार  हैं:   
भारतीय  ररजवध  बैंक  
1. स्टार्टअप  उद्यमोों को  िाह्य िाकणखिक ऋण फ्र े मिक ट के  अोंतगटत 3 कमकियन अमरीकी  डॉिर 
तक  ऋण प्राप्त  करने  की  अनुमकत  है। (अक्ट ू बर , 2016) 
2. भारतीय  प्रकतभूकत  और  किकनमय बोडट (सेबी) द्वारा पोंजीक ृ त किदेशी उद्यम पूोंजी कनिेशक  
(एफिीसीआई) स्टार्टअप्स , चाहे िह ककसी भी क्षेत् में िगे  होों, सकहत स्वचाकित  मागट  के  
अोंतगटत अकधसूचना  सोंख्या फ े मा 20/2000 की  अनुसूची  6 में उखिखखत ककसी भी गकतकिकध 
में सोंिग्‍न   भारतीय  क ों पनी की  100% पूोंजी तक  योगदान  दे सकता  है (अगस्त , 2017) 
3. एक  भारतीय  स्टार्टअप , जो किदेशी सहायता  प्राप्त  है, उि  इकाई  और /या किदेशी 
सहायक  के  कनयाटत /कबिी से उत्पन्न  होने  िािी राकश  द्वारा ककए गए  कनयाटत /कबिी से अिग  
किदेशी किकनमय आय को  जमा करने  के  किए भारत  के  बाहर  एक  बैंक में किदेशी मुद्रा 
खाता  खोि सकता  है। (जून , 2016) 
4. सॉफ्टिेयर  कनयाटतकोों द्वारा दायर  सॉफ्टेक्स फॉमट ऑनिाइन  कर  कदया गया  है। (फरिरी , 
2019)  
5. एफडीआई नीकत  के  अनुसार , स्टार्टअप  की  अिकध को  पररितटनीय  नोर्  की  पररभाषा  के  
उद्देश्य से कदनाोंक 19 फरिरी , 2019 की  डीपीआईआईर्ी  की  अकधसूचना  के  अनुरुप  
बनाया  गया  है। (माचट, 2022)

6.  सेबी (िैकखिक  कनिेश कनकध) (सोंशोधन) किकनयम, 2016, द्वारा कदनाोंक 04-01-2017 
से, ए ों जि फ ों ड द्वारा ककए गए  कनिेश के  किए कनकित अिकध 3 िषट को  घर्ाकर  1 िषट 
तक  सोंशोकधत कर  कदया गया  है।  
7.  ए ों जेि फ ों ड को  किदेशी कनिेश उद्यम पूोंजी उपिमोों में कनिेश करने  की  अनुमकत  है, जो 
सेबी (िैकखिक  कनिेश कनकध) (सोंशोधन) किकनयम, 2016 द्वारा कदनाोंक 04-01-2017 
से प्रदान  की  गई  अन्य एआईएफ के  अनुरूप  उनक े  कनिेश योग्य कॉपटस  के  25% तक  
है।  
8.  सेबी (िैकखिक  कनिेश कनकध) (सोंशोधन) किकनयम, 2016 द्वारा कदनाोंक 04-01-2017 
से ककसी स्कीम में ए ों जि कनिेशकोों की  सोंख्या की  ऊपरी  सीमा को  उनन्चास  से बढाकर  
दो सौ कर  कदया गया  है।   
9.  ककसी भी उद्यम पूोंजी उपिम  में ए ों जेि फ ों ड द्वारा न्यूनतम  कनिेश राकश  की  आिश्यकताओों 
को  सेबी (िैकखिक  कनिेश कनकध) (सोंशोधन) किकनयम, 2016 द्वारा कदनाोंक 04-01-
2017 से पचास  िाख से घर्ाकर  पच्चीस  िाख कर  कदया गया  है।

कदशाकनदेश ” जारी  कर  कदए हैं  (निोंबर, 2018)

14. एक  कनजी क ों पनी, कजसे इसक े कनगमन  की  तारीख  से पाोंच िषट की  अिकध के  किए स्टार्ट -
अप के  रूप  में माना  जाता  है, को  भी राकश  पर  कबना ककसी प्रकतबोंध के  सदस्ोों से जमा 
स्वीकार  करने  की  अनुमकत  है। (कसतोंबर , 2017)  
15. क ों पनी अकधकनयम, 2013 के  उद्देश्य से पररभाकषत  स्टार्टअप : पररभाषा  के  अनुसार , एक  
स्टार्ट -अप क ों पनी का  अथट क ों पनी अकधकनयम, 2013 के  तहत  कनगकमत  एक  कनजी क ों पनी 
से है और  उद्योग सोंिधटन और  आोंतररक व्यापार  किभाग द्वारा जारी  अकधसूचना  के  अनुसार  
"स्टार्टअप " के  रूप  में मान्यता  प्राप्त  है। (जून , 2017) 
16. शेयरधारकोों  से जमा बढाने  के  किए प्रकियात्मक  अनुपािन  से छ ू र् (जैसे कक एक  प्रस्ताि

18. एक  कनजी क ों पनी (यकद ऐसी कनजी क ों पनी एक  स्टार्टअप  है) को  एक  क ै िेंडर िषट के

है और  दोनोों बैठकोों के  बीच का  अोंतर नब्बे कदनोों से कम  ना  हो। (जून , 2017) 
19. क ों पनी कनगमन  के  किए नाम  आरक्षण : कनयम 8, क ों पनी (कनगमन ) कनयम, 2014, 
क ों पनी (कनगमन ) 5िें सोंशोधन कनयम, 2019 के  साथ प्रकतस्थाकपत , जो मौजूदा क ों पनी 
के  नाम , क ों पनी की  अिाोंछनीय नामोों की  नई  श्रेकणयोों के  साथ समानता  पर  नए  कनयम 
प्रदान  करता  है और  उन  शब्ोों की  सूची कजन्हें अनुमोदन  प्राप्त  करने  के  बाद ही उपयोग  
ककया जा सकता  है। (मई, 2019) 
20. क ों पनी (शेयर  पूोंजी और  ऋण) कनयम, 2014 में सोंशोधन: कॉपोर े र्  मामिे मोंत्ािय ने  
16 अगस्त , 2019 को  एक  अकधसूचना  जारी  की , कजसमें अिकध को  कनगमन  की  तारीख  
से 5 िषट से 10 िषट करक े  स्टार्टअप  के  प्रोमोर्रोों और  कनदेशकोों (10% से अकधक इखिर्ी  
धारक ) को  ईएसओपी प्रदान  ककया जा सकता  है और  इस तरह  डीपीआईआईर्ी  अकधसूचना  
में 19 फरिरी , 2019 में उखिखखत प्रािधानोों के  साथ क ों पनी (शेयर  पूोंजी और  ऋण) 
कनयमोों को  श्रेणीबद्ध ककया गया।

21. कॉरपोर े र्  सोशि  ररस्पॉखिकबकिर्ी  फ ों ड्स: क ों पनी अकधकनयम 2013 की  धारा  135 के  
सोंदभट में, अनुसूची  VII में क ें द्र सरकार  या राि  सरकार  या ककसी भी एजेंसी या क ें द्र 
सरकार  या राि  सरकार  के  सािटजकनक  क्षेत् के  उपिम  द्वारा कित्त पोकषत  इनक्यूबेर्रोों में 
योगदान  को  शाकमि करने  के  किए सोंशोधन ककया गया  है, और  इसमें योगदान  करने  के  
किए सािटजकनक  कित्त पोकषत  किश्वकिद्यािय, भारतीय  प्रौद्योकगकी सोंस्थान (आईआईर्ी ), 
राष्ट् र ीय प्रयोगशािाए ँ  और  स्वायत्त कनकाय  (भारतीय  क ृ कष अनुसोंधान पररषद  (आईसीएआर ) 
के  तत्वािधान  में स्थाकपत ), भारतीय  कचककत्सा अनुसोंधान पररषद  (आईसीएमआर ), िैज्ञाकनक 
और  औद्योकगक अनुसोंधान पररषद  (सीएसआईआर ), परमाणु  ऊजाट किभाग (डीएई), रक्षा  
अनुसोंधान और  किकास सोंगठन (डीआरडीओ), किज्ञान और  प्रौद्योकगकी किभाग (डीएसर्ी), 
इिेक्ट र ॉकनक्स और  सूचना  प्रौद्योकगकी मोंत्ािय), जो किज्ञान, प्रौद्योकगकी, इोंजीकनयरर ों ग और  
कचककत्सा में अनुसोंधान करक े  सतत  किकास िक्ष्ोों (एसडीजी) को  बढािा देने  के  उद्देश्य 
से िगे  हुए हैं।  (अक्ट ू बर  2019) 
22. भारत  सरकार  की  ईज ऑफ ड ू इोंग कबजनेस (ईओडीबी) पहि  के  भाग  के  रूप  में 
कॉपोर े र्  कायट  मोंत्ािय ने  मौजूद एसपीआईसीई प्रपत्  के  स््‍थान  पर  नए  एकीक ृ त  िेब प्रपत्  
की  शुरुआत  की  है कजसका नाम  ‘एसपीआईसीई +’ है। एसपीआईसीई  क ें द्र सरकार  के  
तीन  मोंत्ाियोों और  किभागोों (कॉपोर े र्  कायट  मोंत्ािय, श्रम मोंत्ािय और  कित्‍त  मोंत्ािय में 
राजस््‍ि किभाग) की  10 सेिाए ों तथा  राज्‍य सरकार  (महाराष्‍र्र ) की  एक  सेिा प्रदान  कर े गा  
कजससे भारत  में व्‍यिसाय शुरु  करने  की  कई  प्रकियाए ों, समय और  धन  की  बचत  होगी  
तथा  यह 23 फरिरी  2020 से कनगकमत  होने  िािी सभी नई  क ों पकनयोों के  किए िागू  
होगा।  एसपीआईसीई + के  दो भाग  हैं: भाग  क - नई  क ों पकनयोों के  किए नाम  आरक्षण  हेतु  
त था भाग  ख कई  सेिाए ों प्रदान  करता  है जैसे (i) कनगमीकरण  (ii) डीआईएन आबोंर्न 
(iii) अकनिायट रूप  से पैन  जारी  करना  (iv) अकनिायट रूप  से र्ैन  जारी  करना  (v) 
ईपीएफओ का  अकनिायट पोंजीकरण (vi) ईएसआईसी का  अकनिायट पोंजीकरण (vii) 
पेशेिर  कर  का  अकनिायट पोंजीकरण (महाराष्‍र्र ) (viii) क ों पनी के  किए अकनिायट रूप  
से बैंक खाता  खोिना  और  (ix) जीएसर्ीआईएन  (यकद आिेदन ककया गया  है तो ) का  
आबोंर्न। (फरिरी  2020)

(ग): सरकार  ने  ईज़ ऑफ ि  इंग कबजनेस  को  बढावा  दे ने, प ंजी  जुर्ाने  और  अनुपािन  बोझ को  कम
